note: Design contract in the format of github.com/xzhih/app-icon-skill (app-icon-gen). Authored by hand into apps/web/icon.svg; the skill's author-icon/verify scripts were not installed or run.

app_context.job_to_be_done: solve Sudoku alone or race a friend on the same kind of board

style.style_notes: saturated solid blue field, one white board badge, grid drawn as same-blue overlay lines, amber as the single rival accent

icon_intent.metaphor: your Sudoku board with a rival's board right behind it
icon_intent.small_size_readability: must remain clear at 64x64 and recognisable at 32x32

layering_policy.description: Grid gaps are opaque field-coloured bars above the white board; no masks, clip paths or boolean holes.

canvas.alignment: white board centred; rival plate offset up-right

layers.shape_model: rounded square, rotated 12 degrees and offset up-right
must_preserve: peeks out at the top and right at 64px

layers.role: field-coloured overlay bars forming the 3x3 grid
layers.shape_model: four bars as one compound path
must_preserve: two bars each way, 7 of 192 wide
